text: maya: Quick check — prototyped an inline cost toggle for the SLO slider and tightened the burst microcopy. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/new/autoscale-inline-cost kevin: looking now. Short thought: default the cost preview off. too noisy for small edits. :mute: olivia: +1. accessibility: when toggled on, the cost numbers must be in an aria-live region so SR users get immediate feedback. also ensure contrast of the tiny cost label meets 3:1. sam: from research: users liked a tiny inline delta for changes <20%, modal for >20%. keep the inline text terse: 'Est. +$0.08/min' not verbose. jordan: stepper accessibility follow-up: use step=1, and for hold-to-repeat use small acceleration. quick aria snippet: ```html Min reserved GPUs now 4 ``` kevin: burst copy change looks good but let's label it: 'Burst (short-term, billed separately)'. also add a small per-pool hint when a pool doesn't support burst: show a disabled state and tooltip 'Burst not supported on selected pool'. maya: acceptance items I want captured: 1) Cost preview toggle default off + persisted per-project 2) Inline cost microcopy when delta <20% 3) Modal for >20% with breakdown 4) Burst labeled clearly + per-pool disabled tooltip 5) Stepper step=1 + aria-live + visible 4px focus ring 6) Contrast fixes per olivia design-bot: Add to Figma notes: a11y checklist and QA scenarios needed for keyboard-only flow and SR readouts. sam: QA will add tests for: toggle on/off, modal trigger, pool change keeping values, and disabled burst tooltip. assigning AUTOSCALE-4901. olivia: I'll post contrast screenshots and the final short copy by EOD. maya: timeline: ship stepper + burst wording + cost toggle (inline only) this sprint, modal next sprint. pairing: kevin/jordan on stepper and aria. kevin: opening WIP PR and will link to this thread. :rocket: maya: thanks — pinning updated copy to Figma and tagging a11y review.
